jobs.title: SAP ABAP Developer (RICEFW, HANA, BRIM/FSCM)
jobs.description:
Experienced SAP ABAP Developer with expertise in RICEFW, HANA, and SAP BRIM/FSCM, seeking to contribute to cross\-functional teams in a hybrid role based in Pune.
  
We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Developer to join our team. The role focuses on RICEFW development, HANA programming, and SAP BRIM/FSCM solutions. The candidate will work in a hybrid model based in Pune.


**Key responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain ABAP objects including reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows.
* Create and optimize HANA CDS, attribute, analytic, and native views, and develop AMDP/ADBC code.
* Implement and support SAP BRIM/FSCM functionalities, including BRF\+, CRM, SOM, Convergent Charging, and CPQ.
* Integrate SAP solutions with external systems using REST, SOAP, OData, and RFCs.
* Develop and enhance Fiori applications and SAP Gateway services.
* Participate in HANA migration, S/4HANA simplification, and performance tuning.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure solution quality and compliance with SAP best practices.

**Required qualifications**


* Minimum 8 years of SAP ABAP design and development experience.
* At least 8 years of hands‑on experience with RICEFW objects.
* 2\+ years of HANA development and CDS view creation.
* Proven experience with SAP BRIM/FSCM modules and related technologies.
* Strong knowledge of SAP CRM, Fiori, and API integration (REST, SOAP, OData).
* Ability to work 2‑3 days per week on‑site in Pune and overlap 4 hours with US business hours.

**Nice to have**


* Experience with SAP S/4HANA migration projects.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as SAP Cloud Platform.
* Certifications in SAP ABAP or SAP HANA.
* Prior exposure to agile methodologies.

jobs.description:
Position Summary
   

  

 SAP FI Senior Consultant
   

  

 Are you looking for a career trajectory that few other organizations can offer in SAP? With a high\-quality portfolio of businesses and clients, opportunities to work across capabilities, industries, and geographies in roles and on projects aligned with your SAP Finance skills, if this matches your interests and aspirations, Deloitte may be the right fit for you.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 SAP FI Consultant at Deloitte is responsible for ensuring quality solutions are provided to our clients which not only solve the problem at hand but also have longevity and can be easily maintained. Few of the key areas a FI Consultant is involved in are mentioned below:
   

  

 Conduct As\-Is and To\-Be business process workshops while working on implementation project
   

  

 Map Business Processes to SAP
   

  

 Configure SAP to reflect the business requirements.
   

  

 Write Functional Specification / Configuration documents.
   

  

 Exhibit effective communication while working with cross\-functional and technical teams
   

  

**The Team**
 Deloitte’s SAP Service Line is among the world’s largest, with 8,000 global practitioners and over 1,700 SAP implementation projects completed. More than half our consultants have 10\+ years of experience, and Deloitte has been an SAP Global Partner — Services since 1989\. We offer a full range of SAP services, from business case development to deployment, supported by nine solution centers and proprietary accelerators that enhance project delivery. Our CMMI Level 5 and SAS 70\-certified practice covers S4 Hana, CRM, NetWeaver, BO, Development, BASIS \& Infrastructure, and serves all functional areas and industry sectors
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Must have skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
   

  

 6\-10 years of industry experience
   

  

 Domain experience is required for Senior Consultant but is good to have at Consultant level
   

  

 GL – New GL with Segment Reporting
   

  

 Accounts Receivable / FSCM, Accounts Payable / Banking, Cost Center Accounting, Cost Element Accounting \& Internal Orders, Project Systems, Investment Management, Asset Accounting, Product Costing,
   

  

 Worked on implementation project of the most recent version
   

  

 Should have run Blueprint Workshop and should be able to map Business Processes to SAP.
   

  

 Should have Industry Experience.
   

  

**Good To Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**
 Cross process area experience in Product Costing, FSCM, FICA, PSCD and FSCD
   

  

 COPA\- FICA, PSCD, FSCD, Cash Management, Treasury

jobs.title: SAP BRIM Developer
jobs.description:
SAP BRIM Developer / Technical Lead
 



 We are seeking an experienced SAP BRIM Developer with strong hands\-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA, ABAP development, billing and revenue management, and enterprise system integrations.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 \* Analyze existing billing and revenue processes, system configurations, and technical requirements.
 



 \* Design, develop, and implement SAP BRIM solutions and enhancements using SAP S/4HANA and ABAP.
 



 \* Develop complex business logic, technical designs, and system integrations following SAP best practices.
 



 \* Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and development teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
 



 \* Support integration with CRM, financial systems, and other enterprise applications.
 



 \* Troubleshoot technical issues, identify risks, and recommend solutions.
 



 \* Prepare technical documentation, support testing activities, and ensure quality delivery.
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 \* 7\+ years of SAP BRIM and SAP S/4HANA ABAP experience.
 



 \* Hands\-on experience as an SAP Developer or Technical SME on at least two system implementation projects.
 



 \* Strong proficiency in ABAP development, including classic and object\-oriented ABAP.
 



 \* Experience with SAP HANA development tools and techniques.
 



 \* Ability to work independently and deliver complex technical solutions.
 



 \* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
 



 Preferred Skills
 



 \* SAP FI\-CA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable)
 



 \* ABAP CDS, BOPF, AMDP, OData, and BODS
 



 \* SAP HANA Studio, Web IDE, and SAP BTP
 



 \* Lockbox processing and BAI2 bank statement integration
 



 \* Funds management and billing/revenue processing
 



 \* Integration with Microsoft Dynamics CE or other CRM platforms
 



 \* Experience with high\-volume transaction\-processing or billing back\-office systems
 



 \* ServiceNow PPM/ITSM and ITIL practices
 



 Education \& Certifications
 



 \* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Management, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
 



 \* SAP BRIM or SAP ABAP technical certifications preferred.

* Experience in designing end\-to\-end Order\-to\-Cash solutions, process improvements, and automation initiatives.
* Strong expertise in integration testing, UAT, defect management, and production support.
* Experience working with technical teams on enhancements, interfaces, APIs, and system integrations.
* Familiarity with SAP Fiori, S/4HANA business processes, and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

Posted Date 7/19/2026
Description
**We Are:**


Accenture's SAP practice brings reinvention to life through Compressed Transformation \- design thinking, agile delivery, and the latest SAP innovations across S/4HANA Cloud (RISE and GROW), SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Clean Core, and SAP Business AI (Joule, Joule Studio, Generative AI Hub). Powered by our myConcerto platform and Accenture's GenWizard AI\-assisted delivery, we help clients build the intelligent enterprise. We are SAP's most awarded delivery partner and the \#1 recognized integrator across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. We invest continuously in our people through training and a global SAP community \- join us to shape the future of SAP development and extensibility.


**You Are:**


A transformation maven with the skills to help clients meet the challenges of digitization. Your human superpower? Using your know\-how, creativity, and analytical powers to solve clients' most complex technical problems so their companies can do more. You are equally comfortable defining enterprise architecture, leading global development teams, conducting design reviews, and guiding organizations through Clean Core transformation while remaining hands\-on with ABAP Cloud, RAP, CDS, Fiori, and SAP BTP technologies.


You bring the communication and people skills to inspire teams to bring their A\-game and to advise senior client stakeholders with confidence.

* Lead the design, build, and test of SAP custom development and extensibility solutions on S/4HANA and BTP, primarily using ABAP Cloud, RAP, CAP, Fiori, and Clean Core methodologies.
* Drive the transition from classic ABAP to Clean Core; guide custom\-code remediation and released\-API adoption.
* Own technical design for workstreams; conduct code reviews, architecture sign\-offs, and design workshops.
* Leverage Generative AI Hub / Joule Studio to infuse development with SAP Business AI where applicable.

Guide and mentor global delivery teams; communicate effectively across technical levels and geographies.  
* 

*Travel may be required for this role, from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements.*


**Here's what you need:**


* Minimum of 5 years developing SAP applications using S/4HANA ABAP (NetWeaver 7\.4/7\.5\) and ABAP Cloud.
* Minimum 4 years with SAP BTP tools and services (latest Application Development and Automation stack).
* Minimum of 3 years of experience with IS\-U and related technologies
* Minimum 3 years of data modeling using CDS views, AMDP, OData, or related custom development.
* Minimum 3 years of SAP custom development using Fiori\-first, Clean Core, and BTP side\-by\-side approaches, including RAP.
* Minimum 3 years in a technical leadership role (code reviews, architecture sign\-offs, client workshops).
* Prior experience in a Consulting/Advisory role
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate's Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6\-year work experience.
  

  

**Bonus Points If:**


* You have hands\-on experience delivering SAP Utilities solutions across Customer Service, Meter\-to\-Cash, Billing, FICA, Device Management, Work Management, Asset Management, or Energy Data Management.
* You have a minimum of 1 year with Cloud Application Programming (CAP).
* You have led or contributed to large\-scale SAP Utilities transformations, including SAP IS\-U to SAP S/4HANA migrations, CIS modernization programs, or cloud adoption initiatives.
* You have experience with SAP Build Apps, Build Process Automation, Build Work Zone, CAP (Node.js/Java), and event\-driven architectures on SAP BTP.
* You have implemented modern SAP engineering practices including gCTS, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, DevOps, and cloud\-native development frameworks.
* You have practical experience leveraging SAP Business AI, Joule, Joule Studio, Generative AI Hub, RAG\-based solutions, or AI\-assisted development accelerators to improve delivery outcomes.
* You possess a strong understanding of Utilities industry business processes, regulatory requirements, customer operations, and digital customer engagement platforms.

* You have contributed to SAP accelerators, reusable assets, thought leadership, innovation initiatives, or technical communities

* Strong problem\-solving, technical documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience in global SAP implementation, rollout, S/4 upgrade and enhancement projects preferred.
